title: S04 — Closure review (2026-11-22)
body:
# S04 — Closure review (2026-11-22)

Project: S04 — Action registry · Tranche 3 · Issue #3 · Plan: docs/plans/slices/S04-action-registry.md

## Outcome vs acceptance

The S04 gate — derive, manifest, OpenAPI, MCP, invocation and external ingest — is met: the
ActionSpec derive crate serves one declaration over HTTP and MCP, the registry carries 549 actions
and the served-spec lock 580 operations (`--check-lock` green at a9a5f20a), the invocation path is
audited with idempotency, and the external ingest folds through the same registry.

## Evidence

- Deliverable "ActionSpec derive crate" `01a20255-94ae-76d9-9cbf-a9fe7eef56cb` accepted with
  crate and parity-test evidence.
- Deliverable "Registry and spec vocabularies" `01a20255-a3e5-7454-9f11-2ca19de99a6a` accepted
  with the registry/lock evidence.
- Acceptance change `01a2054b-3f86-7959-b2ad-f1edc5b0bb55` (approved, rule under the standing
  delegation); demo credits `01a2054b-578c…` and `01a2054b-57f5…` at the tranche-3 demo.
- Frozen scope baseline `01a20256-44d0-731d-b345-fffc5f3ac9e8`; live delivery contract
  `01a20256-6ede-7d70-aae8-5dbfe681a1b7`; Phase-G review `01a20284-e742…` (compliant) citing the
  published delegation; seven approved typed artefacts and the TOGAF documents published.

## Open items

The nine work packages under the two deliverables remain `open` as planning rows; they are the
deliverables' decomposition, not outstanding scope. The v1 verdict's 36 absent slices are the
programme's product backlog, not S04's, and are carried on the rework board.

## Decision

Close S04. Its manifest's checks execute against this record; nothing is waived.
